inputs.name: sagaId
inputs.description: Saga id (kebab-case). create: the new or existing saga; run: the saga to run.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: create: what the saga must achieve, or the amendment text when the saga already exists.

inputs.name: constraints
inputs.description: Scope, non-goals, safety rules and forbidden areas.

inputs.name: workItems
inputs.description: Known work items or an outline, if the user has one.

inputs.name: verification
inputs.description: How items are verified: commands, environment and expected results.

inputs.name: references
inputs.description: Documents, paths or links to read first.

inputs.name: runOptions
inputs.description: run only: parallelism, stop conditions or extra instructions for the orchestrator.

inputs.name: projectPath
inputs.description: Absolute path to the selected project root. The saga root is <projectPath>/.hagicode/sagas.

inputs.name: omitNonInteractiveHints
inputs.description: Optional. True when interactive control is enabled for the agent CLI running this prompt.
